sentence: This project builds soft robotic devices that perform musculoskeletal manipulation for targeted pain relief.
This project studies how a plant disease-causing microorganism infects cacao and why it infects some plant species and not others.
This project builds an instrument that measures metal-ligands and microbial proteins across large regions of the oceans.
This project tests whether the theft and storage of stinging structures from prey evolved in sea slugs through specialization of phagocytosis.
This project builds risk modeling techniques that help the insurance industry manage the risks of cyber threats and terrorism.
This project builds a framework that makes deep neural networks efficient on mobile edge devices.
This project builds an open compiler that turns AI models into hardware designs.
This project studies how genes, the gut microbiome and culture let some groups of people digest milk as adults.
This project studies how deep learning models learn and represent complex data, including how transformer architectures change data representations during training.
This project tries to find out why groups of schooling fish coordinate well in some situations yet show dysfunction in others.
This project builds mathematical theory to show how environmental fluctuations affect interacting species and how to harvest a population without driving it extinct.
This project builds online modules and experiential learning tools for teaching quantum fundamentals and studies how well they work.
This project builds neural networks for image-processing that represent their own uncertainty, using a mathematical idea called multicalibration.
This project builds a physics-informed machine learning framework that predicts fatigue life and its variation in metal components made by additive manufacturing.
